DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_WhiteShieldDragon:
The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties.
If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it.
When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, 
and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_WhiteShieldDragon:
Can be ridden. 

While in party, 
reduces shield regeneration delay by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> and reduces damage taken by your shield by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
